name: Token decoder
author: friday-core
description: Decodes a JWT (header, payload, issued and expiry times) and base64, base64url, hex, percent-encoded and \u-escaped text. A JWT is only decoded: the signature is never verified, so the result does not prove the token is genuine, and an unsigned alg none or an expired token is called out. Runs locally; the token is not stored or sent.
